name: bett3r-pv3-ai-skills
description: PV3 DDD framework skills: scaffold event-sourced schemas, aggregates, policies, read models, modules, and tests following the PV3 AggregateBuilder/ReadmodelBuilder/PolicyBuilder patterns, plus a ddd-patterns reference. Reads each host repo's package names and paths from its `.esas.config.json`, so the same skills work in any PV3 repo — not just Teselly.
